experiments.name: Sensor enclosure effect
experiments.prerequisites: Exact sensor and approved enclosure fixture
experiments.hypothesis: A protective housing does not materially degrade the measurement under defined conditions.
experiments.method: Compare bare/enclosed repeated sessions; record temperature/airflow/optical/RF effects relevant to that sensor.
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Multimodal degradation replay
experiments.hypothesis: Fusion can detect when one modality becomes misleading.
experiments.method: Remove/corrupt one stream, drift timestamps and invalidate calibration; require explicit degraded state.
experiments.metrics: Error and time to detect invalid modality
experiments.stop_conditions: No averaging inconsistent evidence into false safety
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Relay and data-ferry replay
experiments.prerequisites: Synthetic contact schedule and test recipients
experiments.hypothesis: Store-and-forward can improve deadline delivery under intermittent contacts.
experiments.method: Inject duplicate/lost contacts, expiry, cancellation and recipient nonacknowledgement.
experiments.metrics: Delivery by deadline; duplicate suppression; accurate status
experiments.stop_conditions: Do not infer internet or human help from relay receipt
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Robot safe-state mock
experiments.prerequisites: Mock adapter and defined device-specific state model
experiments.hypothesis: Each task has a deterministic safe recovery contract.
experiments.method: Freeze planner/network or inject unknown gripper/pose; verify the design refuses unsafe continuation.
experiments.metrics: Correct recovery/unknown states; no second owner
experiments.stop_conditions: No universal motor-off behavior across all devices
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Teleoperation and bounded inert-object skill
experiments.prerequisites: Separately reviewed complete platform and physical stop
experiments.hypothesis: A small household-relevant skill can be learned or replayed safely in a controlled workspace.
experiments.method: Collect demonstrations; test held-out inert-object positions; record every failure and intervention.
experiments.metrics: Task success, interventions, placement error and recovery
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials
